claim: 3,117 ADA web accessibility lawsuits were filed in U.S. federal courts in 2025 — a 27% increase from 2024
value_specific: 3,117 federal court website accessibility lawsuits in 2025 (up from 2,452 in 2024). UsableNet projects 5,000+ total including state courts.

sources.name: Seyfarth Shaw ADA Title III — Federal Court Website Accessibility Lawsuit Filings Bounce Back in 2025 (March 25, 2026)
sources.authors: Kristina M. Launey & Minh N. Vu

sources.name: UsableNet — 2025 Year-End Report on Web Accessibility Lawsuits
UsableNet — 2025 Midyear Digital Accessibility Lawsuit Report

context: Website accessibility cases represented 36% of all 8,667 ADA Title III federal lawsuits filed in 2025 (up from 28% in 2024). New York led with 1,021 filings, followed by Florida (961) and Illinois (585). UsableNet projects 5,000+ total when state courts (New York, California) are included. 40% of all federal ADA Title III filings in 2025 came from pro se (self-represented) plaintiffs.
